name: hud_ui_mgr_set_reticle_mode
description: HudUiMgr::SetReticleMode stores the active HUD reticle mode.
known_limits: This is a one-store HUD manager leaf; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD manager/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x411740 validates fastcall ECX as the mode and a single store to g_HudUiMgrReticleMode.
The native viewport activation smoke calls HudUiMgr::SetReticleMode(2) and verifies g_HudUiMgrReticleMode is updated.
